card.name: Noun after 'this' in web notices
card.fires_on: A noun right after a determiner such as 'this' or a short modifier, often in copyright or site-notice text (this review, This material). It also fires on odd spots inside URLs.

modes.label: Noun after 'this'
modes.description: The noun following 'this' in notices about the page or its content.
modes.example: If there is additional discussion of this<< review>>, you may access it through the list

modes.label: Notice phrase nouns
modes.description: Nouns in standard site notes like 'use information' or 'has media related to'.
modes.example: Additional pediatric use<< information>> is approved for Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation

modes.label: URL pieces
modes.description: Parts of web addresses such as the domain ending or a path folder.

card.plain: It lights up on the noun that follows 'this' in website notices and sometimes inside web addresses.
